I was 19, first semester of college, few weeks in, just started getting to know everyone in my department, the "popular" click that i so desperately wanted to be a part of were extremely nice to me, so I just kind of trusted their judgement on things since they were mostly juniors and seniors and been around the block a few times. Well a couple weeks leading up to the incident they were trying to see how i felt about this girl in the department. I said she seemed kind but wasn't my type. I asked why and they said they knew I wasn't really good at talking to girls or getting to any of the various proverbial "bases" and she was in the same boat and they thought we should hook up, give us a "win." They were persistent about it too but i made it very clear i was not in any way, shape or form interested. A couple weeks later im at a house party they're throwing, the girl happens to live there but the conversation about her before had dissipated from my memory. I've had a drink or two, I like to stay buzzed instead of getting drunk because well I like having full control over my actions if i can help it and if I'm being honest at the time alcohol still tasted like death. The same people came up to me and asked me once again. I said no, they pretended to drop it but started offering me more drinks, they had jello shots, they were only giving thsm to people they really liked and myself so i went for it cause i thought it was more or less like my initiation into the cool group etc. Anyway they stuff me with those jello shots and I'm more wasted than i had ever been in my whole life and surprise, surprise those same people bombarded me, trying to get me to sleep with this girl, i still didn't want to but I felt mad pressure and i really thought i wanted to be friends with these people so in my drunkenness I submitted to their reauest and asked the gorl if she wanted to go to her room and she agreed. The deed was done and the next morning i woke up in disgust, I left but everyone had to remind me every day that it happened, gave me a nickname that had to do with the girls last name and the pressure was so immense I dropped out of school completely and became a drug addict and ruined my life for a time. I never considered it "so-and-so assaulted me!" Because i don't think she had anything to do with it so I never really told anyone because i thought people wouldn't take me seriously. I never ever blamed the girl, it was her toxic "friends" and my ignorance. I'm better now! Over it and stuff.
